title: Heterogeneous fallback loop during multi-model rollout caused capacity thrash and rollback failures
creator: Asha Patel
description: During a staged rollout of a multi-variant model bundle (tiny-quant + base-8bit), the orchestrator triggered repeated fallbacks between variants and an older pinned version. That fallback oscillation saturated a small fallback capacity pool and caused several in-flight rollbacks to fail due to pin-state mismatch. The incident produced increased latency and ~38% elevated error rate for 11 minutes for a subset of customers using A/B routing. This ticket tracks the post-incident analysis, mitigation steps taken, and remaining action items to prevent recurrence.
timeline: 2026-03-01T09:12Z - Canary rollout of model-bundle v2026-03-01 started (10% traffic).
2026-03-01T09:15Z - Orchestrator observed higher error rate from variant 'tiny-quant' on region us-west-2 and initiated automated fallback to 'base-8bit'.

2026-03-01T09:16Z - A/B router continued sending small subset of traffic to the canary; health checks reported as flaky leading orchestrator to re-evaluate and re-route back to canary repeatedly (oscillation).
2026-03-01T09:18Z - Fallback pool capacity hit hard limit (10 GPU-equivalent slots). Autoscaler attempted scale but was rate-limited by quota and delayed by 4m.
